title: Evaluation of Small Vision-Language Models on Qualitative Mechanical Problems
abstract: arXiv:2608.22143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Qualitative mechanical problem-solving (QMPS) refers to solving qualitative problems from the mechanical domain. Qualitative problems can be solved with minimal discipline-specific information, without any robust quantitative calculation, generally by using qualitative reasoning and commonsense knowledge. QMPS is a vital aspect of human intelligence that allows us to tackle a wide range of tasks, from simple everyday ones such as turning on a tap to complex tasks in highly demanding and well-paying jobs in various fields, e.g., emergency medicine, plumbing, driving, etc. Employers often use the Bennett Mechanical Comprehension Test (BMCT) to evaluate job candidates' ability to solve such problems. In this work, we assess two state-of-the-art multimodal models, Gemma-3 and Qwen-VL, on their ability to interpret mechanical problem images by eliciting a step-by-step chain of thought (CoT) and a final answer. translated_title: 小型视觉语言模型在定性力学问题上的评估
translated_abstract: 定性力学问题求解（QMPS）指的是解决力学领域的定性问题。这类问题可以仅凭少量学科特定信息解决，无需进行稳健的定量计算，通常依靠定性推理和常识知识。QMPS是人类智能的重要方面，使我们能够处理从简单的日常任务（如打开水龙头）到各种高要求、高薪职业中的复杂任务（如急诊医学、管道工、驾驶等）。雇主常使用班尼特机械理解测试（BMCT）来评估求职者解决此类问题的能力。在本研究中，我们评估了两种最先进的多模态模型——Gemma-3和Qwen-VL——通过引导逐步思维链（CoT）和最终答案，来检验它们解读力学问题图像的能力。每张图像固有地编码了相关信息。
tldr: 本研究评估了两种小型视觉语言模型（Gemma-3和Qwen-VL）在定性力学问题求解中的表现，通过思维链方法测试其图像理解能力。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates two small vision-language models (Gemma-3 and Qwen-VL) on qualitative mechanical problem-solving, testing their image comprehension via chain-of-thought prompting.
